documents.title: Python programming tutorial
documents.text: Python is a programming language. This tutorial introduces Python syntax, functions, lists and dictionaries. Beginners can write small programs and learn programming through examples. Python modules organize reusable code.

documents.title: SQLite database and SQL
documents.text: SQLite is an embedded database engine. SQL statements create tables, insert records and select data. A database transaction commits changes atomically. SQL indexes speed up database queries. Python applications can access SQLite.

documents.title: HTTP web requests
documents.text: HTTP transfers web documents between a client and a server. A browser sends an HTTP request. The server returns a response with headers and a body. HTTPS protects traffic using encryption. Status codes describe success or failure.

documents.title: Probabilistic search with BM25
documents.text: BM25 is a probabilistic search ranking model. Search systems rank documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and document length. BM25 reduces the impact of repeated terms. Probabilistic retrieval estimates relative relevance without requiring all query words.

documents.title: Search quality evaluation
documents.text: Search evaluation requires independent relevance judgments. Precision measures the relevant fraction of retrieved documents. Recall measures coverage of relevant documents. Average precision evaluates ranking quality. Search quality should be tested on several queries.

documents.title: Machine learning classification
documents.text: Machine learning classification predicts labels from training data. A classifier learns patterns from examples. Machine learning evaluation uses a separate test set. Precision and recall measure classification quality. Features represent input data.

documents.title: TCP network transport
documents.text: TCP provides reliable network transport between computers. Network connections deliver ordered bytes and recover lost packets. Web clients use transport connections for requests. HTTP protocols operate above transport layers.

documents.title: Python SQLite programming
documents.text: Python includes a SQLite database interface. Python programming can connect to a database, execute SQL and fetch rows. Parameter binding separates SQL values from commands. Transactions protect database updates. This tutorial shows Python database programming.

documents.title: Boolean information retrieval
documents.text: Boolean search combines terms with AND, OR and NOT. An inverted index maps terms to documents. Boolean retrieval selects matching documents without a probabilistic ranking score. Search queries may require every word or any word.

documents.title: Bread baking guide
documents.text: Bread baking combines flour, water, salt and yeast. Kneading develops dough structure. Let dough rise before baking. A hot oven creates a crisp crust. This guide explains basic cooking steps.

documents.title: Python snake habitat
documents.text: A python is a large snake found in warm habitats. The python hunts small animals and uses camouflage. Wildlife conservation protects snakes and their habitats. A python does not use venom.

documents.title: Writing software in a beginner language
documents.text: A beginner can write software using variables, loops and functions. Readable syntax makes this scripting language useful for education. Exercises explain how to build programs and organize modules. The subject is the language named after a comedy group.
